_comment: Venues that ticket through VenuePilot (public GraphQL API, no key). Each site: account_ids from the venue's widget config (window.venuepilotSettings.general.accountIds), a Mapsee category, and a venue block for location (the public API returns only the venue NAME, so supply address+city+region for the sync to geocode, or lat+lon). Single venue per site.

_not_included.Baba Yaga (VenuePilot account 2906): Baba Yaga - VenuePilot's GraphQL endpoint. RETIRED 2026-09-30 under the robots line (robots.txt binds a publisher's own pages and feeds): https://www.venuepilot.co/robots.txt answers `Disallow: /` to every crawler (`User-agent: *`), and our POST /graphql falls under it. To restore: once robots.txt lets MapseeAggregator read that path, copy the entry back from venuepilot_sources.json at f8465bf; `verify` will then pass it.
